about: Flash dip (docs/strategy.md, src/flash.py): BTC falls `drop` under its high of the last `window_h` hours, outside quiet hours, with no position open: BUY. Size: `risk_of_room` of the room above the $950 fail level at risk on the `stop` plus `exit_slip`, never more than the cash, never more than the finishing trade needs. Exits from the real fill: +target, -stop, or after hold_h hours. Tested in analyses/backtests/2026-10-19-flash-dip-vs-dip-setup.md and 2026-11-12-more-active.md (Nuno chose 4% in 6h and 35% of the room on 12 Nov 2026). Set enabled to false to pause it. Change numbers only with Nuno's agreement.
